platform: macOS ARM64 with local Linux ARM64 Docker engine
checks_before_failure: The explicit executable mode allowed the nonroot initializer to start.
The pinned database started at port 35432, created the scoped roles and accepted both private logins from a disposable same-network PostgreSQL client.
The exact scratch image under its configured UID had mode 0644 on /etc. Go could not read the Docker-generated resolver file and fell back to loopback DNS.
failure: The scratch image added the CA bundle under /etc using COPY --chmod=0644. BuildKit applied that mode to the implicit /etc directories and prevented traversal. The initializer failed before owner database access.
repair: Copy the public bundle as a single root-level file and point SSL_CERT_FILE to it. Docker can create its own traversable /etc directory and resolver files.
